item.title: Hegseth says he's cutting generals and admirals by 20%, ousting "woke"
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said in a speech on Wednesday that the Pentagon is eliminating roughly 1 in 5 generals and admirals during the second Trump administration through firing or position cuts.

item.title: Why Senate Democrats blocked a bill to limit lawmakers' stock trades
item.description: A bill that would have prohibited lawmakers and their family members from buying publicly-traded stocks was blocked by Senate Democrats on Wednesday over an attached rider on voter ID laws. CBS News' Taurean Small reports.

item.title: Details emerge in case of former Cornell student alleging rape by frat members
item.description: A woman, identified only as Jane Doe, alleges she was gang-raped by seven fraternity members in 2024 and accuses Cornell University of failing to protect her.

item.title: Co-pilot stabs pilot, tries to crash passenger jet en route to Israel, Netanyahu says
item.description: Israeli officials say passengers helped thwart an "attempted jihadist terror attack" by a FlyDubai pilot who allegedly stabbed his fellow cockpit crew member, intent on crashing the plane.

item.title: Passengers recount terrifying attempted hijack of Dubai-to-Israel flight
item.description: Passenger Ron Levi tells CBS News the attempted hijack of a Dubai-to-Israel flight was "the scariest thing possible."

item.title: ASU hockey coach put on leave after player collapsed during workout
item.description: Matthew Mayich, a 21-year-old sophomore from Ontario, Canada, collapsed during a workout on Aug. 20 and remains hospitalized.

item.title: ASU hockey coach on leave after outdoor workout puts player on life support
item.description: An Arizona State University hockey coach was put on leave on Wednesday after one of his players collapsed during an outdoor workout last month. That player, a sophomore defenseman, is now on life support, with his family and teammates calling for more accountability.

item.title: Netanyahu says it's too early to determine motive in cockpit stabbing
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu indicated to CBS News that the motive of the co-pilot accused of stabbing his fellow pilot on a passenger jet bound from Dubai to Tel Aviv is still unknown.

item.title: Middle East oil exports back to 80% of prewar levels, but prices still high
item.description: The Middle East's oil exports have risen to about 80% of prewar levels, according to oil tracker Kpler, but prices have remained high. CBS News' Aaron Maclean has more.

item.title: AI expert skeptical of companies' pledge to implement safety measures
item.description: A White House meeting on AI regulation ended with tech leaders agreeing on an AI "constitution." Stuart Russell, president of the International Association for Safe and Ethical AI, joins "The Daily Report" to break it down.

item.title: Christa Pike's execution can proceed, Supreme Court rules
item.description: A last-minute court order had temporarily halted Tennessee's plans to execute Christa Pike earlier Wednesday.

item.title: Supreme Court allows Christa Pike's execution
item.description: The Supreme Court has vacated a lower court's order and cleared the way for Tennessee's execution of Christa Pike. Pike would be the only woman executed in Tennessee in the last 200 years. CBS News' Skyler Henry reports.

item.title: GOP Senate candidate Ken Paxton says Trump's midterm convention hurt him in leaked audio
item.description: Republican Senate candidate Ken Paxton can be heard in a leaked audio recording observing that President Trump's GOP midterms convention was politically harmful for the GOP. CBS News' Zak Hudak has more.

item.title: District attorney in Cornell case claims he never saw police transcript with alleged rape victim
item.description: The district attorney in the alleged Cornell University rape case says he never saw a transcript of the accuser's conversation with campus police where she said she was raped. CBS News' Anna Schecter has more details.

item.title: Iran says it's considering ceasefire counterproposal
item.description: Iranian state media said the regime has received a full U.S. response to its proposal for a ceasefire and the phased reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran says it received U.S. counterproposal to ceasefire plan
item.description: Iran says it has received a U.S. counterproposal to the seven-day ceasefire plan that was rejected by the White House. CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi has more.

item.title: Terrifying footage shows passengers' fight for control of FlyDubai plane after alleged stabbing
item.description: Footage shot by passengers aboard the FlyDubai flight where a pilot was stabbed on Wednesday shows their brave fight for control of the aircraft. CBS News' Imtiaz Tyab reports and journalist Neria Kraus, who reported on the incident for the Free Press, joins CBS News to discuss. The Free Press is a Paramount publication.

item.title: Extended interview: Benjamin Netanyahu discusses alleged pilot stabbing on flight to Israel
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu speaks with Tony Dokoupil about Wednesday's incident aboard a FlyDubai flight to Israel where the co-pilot allegedly stabbed the pilot and tried to crash the plane.

item.title: Alleged pilot stabbing aboard Israel-bound flight investigated as possible terrorism
item.description: New details are emerging on the stabbing that took place aboard an Israel-bound FlyDubai flight on Wednesday. CBS News' Tina Kraus reports and Neria Kraus, a senior journalist and Middle East analyst who reported on the incident for the Free Press, joins "The Daily Report" to discuss. The Free Press is a Paramount publication.

item.title: Two best friends show that while chemo fights cancer, it's friends who can save your life
item.description: Two best friends decided to share one of their cancer journeys online, with hopes of spreading a message on friendship and healing. Tony Dokoupil has the story.

item.title: Pete Hegseth boasts about reshaping military while U.S. is at war with Iran
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth spoke on what he called "PT at the Pentagon" on the day the U.S. military announced the completion of its troop pullout from Iraq. Charlie D'Agata reports.

item.title: White House defends Trump's use of taxpayer money for ad campaign
item.description: The White House defended the Trump administration's use of taxpayer dollars for a series of TV ads promoting President Trump in the run-up to the midterm elections. Nancy Cordes reports.

item.title: Ken Paxton says midterm convention hurt GOP in leaked audio
item.description: Texas Republican Senate candidate Ken Paxton reportedly told donors "everybody's numbers are down" after the recent GOP midterm convention. Paxton's comments were leaked to the New York Times. Republican strategist Tricia McLaughlin and Democratic strategist Chuck Rocha join "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: On Cornell student's 2024 rape claim, DA says, "I never saw that statement"
item.description: According to a Cornell police transcript, Jane Doe said, "I can say with 100% confidence I was raped," three weeks after the alleged incident. The Tompkins County District Attorney now says the rape claim never crossed his desk. Tom Hanson reports.

item.title: Trump unveils South Korean investment in Alaska gas pipeline
item.description: This marks the second time in three days President Trump has sought to highlight planned foreign investments in states where GOP Senate candidates are in tight election campaigns

item.title: Fed watchdog finds no laws broken in $2.5 billion Fed renovation
item.description: The Federal Reserve inspector general also did not find fault with features the White House had complained were "ostentatious" and not compliant with the approved plans.

item.title: Trump deflects on audio of Paxton calling GOP convention a drag on polls
item.description: Republican Senate candidate Ken Paxton reportedly told donors that "everybody's numbers are down" after a midterm convention in Dallas that touted both Paxton's campaign and President Trump's record.

item.title: Russia is stockpiling weapons to intensify attacks on Ukraine, analysts say
item.description: Russia has been stockpiling "jet-powered drones," a new model of long-range strike drones that fly faster and are harder to intercept.

item.title: Stats don't support Flock's claim of solving 1 million crimes
item.description: Flock has made unsupported or inconsistent statistical claims in the past, according to a CBS News review and criminal justice experts.

item.title: New SNAP rules take effect Oct. 1, raising fears of more benefit cuts
item.description: More than 5 million Americans have lost food-stamp benefits since 2025. "I have to prove that I'm sick," one SNAP recipient said.
